description: Source code for Zephyr RTOS kernel queue implementation, including queue initialization, insertion, removal, and synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: z_queue_node_peek
methods.description: Retrieves data from a queue node, freeing the node if needed.

methods.name: z_impl_k_queue_init
methods.description: Initializes a queue object.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_queue_init
methods.description: Verifies and calls queue initialization in user space.

methods.name: prepare_thread_to_run
methods.description: Prepares a thread to run with specified data.

methods.name: handle_poll_events
methods.description: Handles poll events for a queue.

methods.name: z_impl_k_queue_cancel_wait
methods.description: Cancels a wait operation on a queue.

methods.name: queue_insert
methods.description: Inserts data into the queue, with optional allocation and append mode.

methods.name: k_queue_insert
methods.description: Public API to insert data into the queue.

methods.name: k_queue_append
methods.description: Appends data to the end of the queue.

methods.name: k_queue_prepend
methods.description: Prepends data to the start of the queue.

methods.name: z_impl_k_queue_alloc_append
methods.description: Allocates and appends data to the queue.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_queue_alloc_append
methods.description: Verifies and calls alloc_append in user space.

methods.name: z_impl_k_queue_alloc_prepend
methods.description: Allocates and prepends data to the queue.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_queue_alloc_prepend
methods.description: Verifies and calls alloc_prepend in user space.

methods.name: k_queue_append_list
methods.description: Appends a list of nodes to the queue.

methods.name: k_queue_merge_slist
methods.description: Merges a singly linked list into the queue.

methods.name: z_impl_k_queue_get
methods.description: Retrieves data from the queue, blocking if empty.

methods.description: Removes specific data from the queue.

methods.description: Appends data only if it is not already in the queue.
